name: @kitr/kit-site
description: kitr new --kit site: A marketing site: server-rendered with prerendering, SEO heads, i18n (en/de), a blog and a newsletter form on a controller.

kitr.name: site
kitr.title: Site kit
kitr.summary: Start a marketing site: server-rendered, prerendered, SEO heads, i18n, a blog and a newsletter form.

kit.audience: Teams launching a marketing site that will grow forms, a blog and more than one language.

highlights.title: Prerendered pages
highlights.text: Home, pricing and a blog, written to HTML at build time and listed in `config/seo.ts`.

highlights.title: Two languages
highlights.text: English and German in `app/locales/`, with a locale switch kept in a cookie.

highlights.title: A newsletter form
highlights.text: The form posts to `server/controllers/newsletter-controller.ts`, and a test covers it.

highlights.title: Ready to share
highlights.text: Page titles, share tags and analytics are configured in `config/`.

run: Vitest, starting with the newsletter test
